name: Critique And Review Content
description: Allows users to review or critique the content of other users. Useful for collaboration and to enrich content workflow.
project_description: Critique and Review Content adds a structured peer-review workflow to node content. A reviewer (any authenticated user who can see the review block on a node page and is not the node's author) fills in a template of predefined Review Items -- each a titled section with a basic_html rich-text body -- and saves them as a draft or finalises them. Reviews are stored per user, per node, and per node revision (vid) in a dedicated critique_and_review_reviews database table (defined in hook_schema, not as a Drupal entity). Finished reviews are surfaced back to the content author on the node edit form via hook_form_alter, grouped under vertical tabs by reviewer. An administrator configures which content types are reviewable, the default Review Item titles and instructions, an optional intro/help text, whether reviewers may add their own ad hoc Review Items, and whether the module CSS is attached, via a settings form at /admin/config/content/critique_and_review. The review UI is delivered as a block plugin (Critique And Review Block) placed via the block layout; block visibility (role, page, content type) is the main mechanism for restricting who can review. Useful for editorial workflows, proofreading, fact-checking, educational content sign-off, and any case where drafts need peer feedback before publication.
